text.title: SDD Promotion Gate Checklist Failure Modes
text.summary: 5 antipatterns observed in real deployments, three at the backlog → todo gate and two at the in-progress → done gate. Each pairs a concrete symptom with sourced root-cause and a concrete fix the author can apply.

antipattern.symptom: Reviewer reads spec and 'feels good'; downstream tasks fail on missing test-plan.
spec.md absent at promotion; tasks cannot be generated.
Approval shown as 'team'; no one can defend the decision.
readiness.md exists but several items are blank or marked "n/a" without justification.
antipattern.root-cause: Blank ≠ pass. The done gate is binary; blanks block.
antipattern.fix: Tick every item with evidence or a written justification before moving the feature.

antipattern.symptom: API tests skipped because "the change was small" although a backend file changed.
antipattern.root-cause: The conditional is on the diff, not on the developer's estimate of impact.
antipattern.fix: Apply conditionals-from-diff: a backend file in the diff makes API tests REQUIRED.
